findings.title: Conflict-marker-like lines remain in the shared coordination history
findings.detail: Structural scan found 7 marker-like lines in COORDINATION.md (historical append/rebase remnants). The file is documentation; no runtime code depends on these lines. Review before editing because board history is append-only.

findings.title: The published sporting slate is a dated snapshot, not a live feed
findings.detail: This desk's official source bundle is dated 2026-10-23; scheduled fixtures can start or change after capture. Re-check the governing-body source before treating a row as current or bettable.

findings.title: OLBG consensus/odds widgets vary by visitor region
findings.detail: Live OLBG event detail pages accessed from the US show false Expired badges and blank WIN @ values on upcoming events; header percentage denominators visibly concatenate strings. OLBG tip counts and any absent quote are not used as line inputs.

findings.title: Captured OLBG hubs are not a complete worldwide match inventory
findings.detail: The inventory is the hub-tip data present in the dated capture, and only event rows discoverable there are listed. Golf returned no live tip objects; Snooker had expired tips at hub capture; Rugby League listings were 2027 outright futures, not 2026 matches. Official fixture tables may contain matches OLBG did not list.

findings.title: Fair prices are not bookmaker offers or evidence of market availability
findings.detail: Zenith prices are reciprocal fair prices from stored probabilities. No claim is made that a bookmaker lists the exact handicap/total, accepts a wager, or offers the displayed price. The user's requested range is screened on our fair American price only.

findings.title: Injury reporting is available only for NBA in the checked official material
findings.detail: An official NBA report for 2026-10-23 5:15 PM ET was read. Other sources in this sample did not supply a comprehensive fixture-specific injury report, so blank injury fields mean not captured, not no injuries. One inherited row-level parse in the source bundle appears to misalign a player/team cell; Zenith withholds those parsed player claims instead of repeating them.
findings.artifact: data/cadence/fixtures.json (source layer); Zenith fixture injury facts withheld

findings.title: OLBG hub odds and tip percentages have location-sensitive and arithmetic defects
findings.detail: The tip hub objects are a dated (20:31–20:36Z) capture. Direct event pages read in this session showed string-concatenated header denominators and false Expired badges for upcoming fixtures; displayed tip percentages therefore are published as source fields, not reused as probabilities.

findings.title: Gaelic Sports is split into two OLBG sport routes
findings.detail: OLBG lists Gaelic Football id 25 and Hurling id 26 as separate routes; this desk groups both beneath the requested Gaelic Sports category while preserving the original sub-sport value.
